editor.hint.none: Select a control in the list or on the canvas to edit properties.
editor.hint.multi: Multiple selection: differing values show *; Apply writes only changed fields to all selected items.
editor.hint.main: Menu colors/image are written to :root (--menu-*). Priority: image > solid color.
editor.hint.eq: If “Enable EQ skin” is off, the player falls back to the system EQ window. The Window group below edits opacity / board.
editor.hint.window: board/nine-slice order: T→R→B→L. board is the shadow edge (docking uses the real frame).
editor.hint.list: List: row height and cover size are independent; enable list covers and set cover size; selection and scrollbar colors; regular text/background are under Text and Background. Pick a ttf/otf from the skin folder.
editor.hint.lyrics: Lyrics: under Text set colors, karaoke fill on/off, active color, karaoke-fill color, alignment, font/size, active-line size, line height, far opacity / fade range, and focus Y % (from top; 50 = center). Far opacity 100 disables fading; active-line size 0 matches normal font size.
editor.hint.decor: Decoration: transparent PNG in Sprites. Background is only background-image + background-color; with an image, the color tints it; with no image, the color fills.
editor.hint.bands: EQ: sprites can set track/fill/thumb; band offsets can be edited as X/Y or dragged on the canvas. Writes --band-offset-x/y.
editor.hint.slider: Slider: set track/fill/thumb sprites; use Thumb travel % for thumb-center range (--thumb-offset).
editor.hint.play_pause: Play/Pause: Combined writes transport.play_pause (same slot); unchecked uses separate play / pause.
editor.hint.display: main.lcd / LED: switch sprite or font (--display) at the top of Text. Font mode can set color / font; LED can also edit content.
editor.hint.title_lib: Library button: content is the caption; background uses --list-bg (Background color); you can also place a PNG in Sprites. playlist.opts opens the library-view menu.
editor.hint.title: Window title: edit the caption in content (CSS content). Empty uses the skin name / Playlist / Equalizer defaults.
editor.hint.font: Text: pick a system font from the list, or browse a ttf/otf in the skin folder (font-family + url).
editor.hint.default: Properties are grouped by function. General has position, size, anchor, and nine-slice. Sprites can browse PNGs.
editor.hint.intro: Window background: background-image + background-color (tint when both; color alone if no image). Artist backdrop, when enabled, takes priority. Sprite slots can change the window-frame PNG.
editor.tip.left: left: X of the control’s left edge relative to its window (pixels).
editor.tip.top: top: Y of the control’s top edge relative to its window (pixels).
editor.tip.width: width: control width (pixels). Use “Use image size” to match the sprite PNG.
editor.tip.height: height: control height (pixels). Use “Use image size” to match the sprite PNG.
editor.tip.use_img_size: Use image size: write width/height from the current sprite PNG so CSS matches the image.
editor.tip.pin: pin: X/Y from 0 to 1 — parent reference region; follows that corner/edge when the parent resizes (e.g. 1 1 = bottom-right).
editor.tip.origin: origin: X/Y from 0 to 1 — self alignment point; left/top offset from pin places this point (e.g. 0 1 = bottom-left of self).
editor.tip.stretch: stretch: width/height set the design size; on resize, flex grow adds a share (or all) of parent ΔW/ΔH by group (--flex-x/y: grow).
editor.tip.flex_group: stretch group: siblings under the same parent with the same group id and flex grow share ΔW/ΔH (--flex-group-x/y, default 1).
editor.tip.nine_slice: Nine-slice --nine-slice: preserved T/R/B/L edges (px). Corners/edges stay undistorted; center stretches. All 0 = stretch the whole image.
editor.tip.nine_slice_tile: When on, the nine-slice is cut into 8 border patches rebaked to the window size; the center keeps its source size and tiles. When off, the old stretch-the-center nine-slice is used.
editor.tip.fit_bounds_roles: Drag components to surround here from the left list. The decoration follows their combined bounds as they move or stretch.
editor.tip.fit_bounds_padding: Adds top, right, bottom, and left space outside the combined target bounds.
editor.tip.fit_bounds_delete: Removes selected components from the target list; the Delete key also works.
editor.tip.text_color: color: text color; for play-mode, tints sprites (multiplied at load). (#RGB / #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB).
editor.tip.active_color: --active-color: current lyrics line; after karaoke fill is set, this is the unsung color.
editor.tip.karaoke_fill: --karaoke-fill: karaoke fill (left to right). Lyrics fall back to active color; the track bar falls back to the accent color.
editor.tip.track_karaoke: --karaoke: karaoke fill when main.track shows the current line. Requires Show lyrics in track title.
editor.tip.lyrics_nudge_side: --lyrics-nudge-side: place lyric nudge triangles (◀▶) on the left or right of main.track. Default left.
editor.tip.lyrics_karaoke: --karaoke: progressive karaoke fill on the current lyrics line. On by default; when off, the active line uses solid active color.
editor.tip.lyrics_drag: --lyrics-drag: allow dragging lyrics to seek. On by default; when off the lyrics area does not capture the mouse (clicks pass through for window drag).
editor.tip.menu_bg: Menu background --menu-bg: context/tray menu fill (:root). Empty follows system light/dark.
editor.tip.menu_fg: Menu text --menu-fg: context/tray menu text (:root). Empty follows system light/dark.
editor.tip.menu_bg_img: Menu image --menu-bg-image: static context-menu backdrop (:root url). Image wins over solid color.
editor.tip.menu_fit: Menu fit --menu-backdrop-fit: cover crop / contain fit / fill stretch.
editor.tip.text_align: text-align: horizontal left / center / right; (default) writes no declaration.
editor.tip.vertical_align: vertical-align: top / middle / bottom; (default) writes no declaration (centered).
editor.tip.font: Font: pick a system font from the list; Browse loads ttf/otf from the skin folder with a local url.
editor.tip.font_size: Font size: text size in pixels (font-size).
editor.tip.spin_when: spin-when: controls when rotation occurs. never = do not rotate; playing = rotate during playback; always = rotate continuously. Maps to CSS --spin-when.
editor.tip.spin_speed: spin-speed: rotation speed in rpm (revolutions per minute). Written to CSS --spin-speed, for example 10rpm.
editor.tip.spin_dir: spin-dir: cw clockwise, ccw counter-clockwise. CSS --spin-direction.
editor.tip.hover_breathe: hover-breathe: pulse semi-transparent pixels in the hover image (e.g. glow). CSS --hover-breathe.
editor.tip.display: Display (main.lcd / LED): sprite digit/PNG or font (CSS --display: image|font). Switch here after selecting main.lcd; font mode can set color / font-*.
editor.tip.cover_circle: Circle mask: crop the main cover or list avatar to an inscribed circle (CSS --cover-shape: circle). Can combine with spin.
editor.tip.cover_shape: Cover shape: rectangle / circle / rounded rect (CSS --cover-shape: circle|rounded). Corner radius uses the same role --corner-radius; if omitted, about 1/8 of the short side. Can combine with spin.
editor.tip.sep_dir: direction: separator direction. vertical splits left/right; horizontal splits top/bottom.
editor.tip.split_share: split-share: when the window resizes, share ΔW equally across columns (equal). Dragging a splitter still keeps outer left/right edges fixed.
editor.tip.split_min: split-min: minimum pane size (--split-min-size, px vs design width). 0=unset (engine falls back to design×50%). Drag and window resize will not go below this.
editor.tip.peer_min: peer-min: minimum size of the other pane (--split-peer-min).
editor.tip.hmin: h-min: minimum height for horizontal splits (--split-h-min).
editor.tip.west: --split-west: dock/split toward the west (left). Used to align child windows with the main window.
editor.tip.north: --split-north: dock/split toward the north (top). Used to align child windows with the main window.
editor.tip.win_op: Window opacity: overall 0–100 (--window-opacity). 100 is fully opaque.
editor.tip.eq_enabled: Enable EQ skin: writes --eq-enabled on eq.window. Unchecked: the player treats the skin as having no EQ and uses the system fallback.
editor.tip.corner: Corner radius: logical px (--corner-radius / border-radius). 0 = square; ignored when the main window is maximized.
editor.tip.board: board: shadow/decor edges (T→R→B→L). Docking uses the client area after removing board.
editor.tip.playlist_dock_side: --dock-side: default side of the standalone playlist window relative to the main window (top/bottom/left/right). Default bottom (match content width); left/right match content height. Affects startup/skin-change/reset placement only; users can still drag and snap freely.
editor.tip.backdrop: Full backdrop: main-window background. Priority: artist cover > static image > color.
editor.tip.bg_color: Background color (background-color) for window/list/decoration. With an image it tints the bitmap; without an image it fills.
editor.tip.bg_img: Static backdrop: window background-image; tinted by background-color when both are set.
editor.tip.backdrop_artist: Prefer artist cover: while playing, prefer the current track cover as backdrop (editor shows a preview).
editor.tip.fit: Fit: cover crop-to-fill / contain fit / fill stretch.
editor.tip.play_pause: Combined play/pause: both actions become transport.play_pause; unchecked uses transport.play / transport.pause. Combined also aligns pause geometry to play.
editor.tip.row_height: Row height: lists use --row-height for each row; lyrics use --line-height for line spacing (px). A taller list row can show two lines in the preview; lyrics use it to control multi-line scrolling spacing.
editor.tip.lyrics_fade_min: Far opacity: opacity 0–100 of lines farthest from the current lyric (--lyrics-fade-min). 100 disables fading.
editor.tip.lyrics_fade_range: Fade range: lines from current to reach far opacity (--lyrics-fade-range, default 4).
editor.tip.lyrics_focus_y: Focus Y %: vertical anchor of the current lyric line within the lyrics area, 0–100 from top (--lyrics-focus-y). 0=top, 50=center (default), 100=bottom.
editor.tip.lyrics_active_size: Active line size: font size in px for the currently singing line (--lyrics-active-size). 0 = same as Font size; larger values enlarge the active line.
editor.tip.list_avatar: Enable list covers: show cover or placeholder; off requests no covers.
editor.tip.list_backdrop_cover: Use cover as background: fill playlist.list with the selected left-pane library row cover; if none, draw nothing (no placeholder). Available when either list pane is selected.
editor.tip.library_scope: Pane scope: what this library pane shows. "All" keeps the legacy behaviour where playlists and library categories can be switched; "Playlists only" lists just playlists; "Library categories only" lists artists/albums/genres and the smart views. Declare a second pane playlist.library2 to get a MusicBee-style split library.
editor.tip.library_bottom_bar: Show bottom bar: the toolbar at the bottom of the list (view mode, find, sort, filter). When off, the pane reserves no space for it and rows fill the whole area. Set on a library pane to affect that pane, or on playlist.list to affect the track list.
editor.tip.avatar_size: Cover size: list cover side (--avatar-size, px), independent of row height and clamped to the row.
editor.tip.list_cover_default: Default cover: image shown when a list cover cannot be fetched; shared with the main cover placeholder (cover.placeholder).
editor.tip.sel_bg: Selected background: selected-row fill (--row-sel-bg / --sel-bg). Overrides row_selected artwork when set.
editor.tip.sb_track: Scrollbar track: list scrollbar background (--scrollbar-track), #RRGGBBAA. Empty removes the declaration.
editor.tip.sb_thumb: Scrollbar thumb: color of the list scrollbar thumb (--scrollbar-thumb), in #RRGGBBAA format.
editor.tip.sb_hover: Thumb hover: color used when the pointer hovers over the scrollbar thumb (--scrollbar-thumb-hover), in #RRGGBBAA format.
editor.tip.band_x: Offset X: horizontal offset of the current EQ band from even spacing (--band-offset-x); also draggable on the canvas.
editor.tip.band_y: Offset Y: vertical offset of the current EQ band from even spacing (--band-offset-y); also draggable on the canvas.
editor.tip.apply: Apply: write changed fields back to the selection (multi-select writes only changed fields).
editor.tip.sec_common: General: shared layout — position, size, anchor, nine-slice.
editor.tip.sec_text: Text: color, alignment, caption, and font.
editor.tip.title_text: Caption: window title (CSS content / --title-text). Empty uses the skin name or a default. Drawn by the engine; do not bake it into the PNG.
editor.tip.sec_spin: Spin: when, how fast, and which way decorations/covers rotate.
editor.tip.sec_split: Split / Dock: separator direction and min sizes for docking child windows.
editor.tip.sec_window: Window: enable switch (EQ only), opacities, corner radius, and board shadow edges.
editor.tip.sec_bg: Window background: color/image, artist backdrop, theme color, and Lua. Lists/decorations only use background color.
editor.tip.sec_menu: Menu: context/tray menu colors and backdrop image (:root).
editor.tip.lua_source: Lua window-effect source (choose one): Shared writes --lua-ui-effect (scripts/effects/*.lua); Built-in writes --lua-ui-script (a .lua inside the skin). Enabled when the player loads the skin. “(None)” or an empty path means unbound.
editor.tip.lua_shared: Shared script: writes --lua-ui-effect on main.window (script name under scripts/effects/). Selecting this clears the built-in binding.
editor.tip.lua_builtin: Skin built-in: writes --lua-ui-script on main.window (relative path such as lua/effect.lua). Selecting this clears the shared binding; files outside the skin folder are copied into lua/.
editor.tip.theme_color: Theme color: --theme-color on main.window for Lua effects (engine.theme_color). Empty = unset. #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA.
editor.tip.sec_list: List: row height, cover size, selection colors, and scrollbar colors.
editor.tip.bands: EQ: X/Y offsets of each band from even spacing.
editor.tip.to_jpg: Convert to JPG: encode the current image as JPEG (no alpha; translucent pixels flatten onto white), switch the path to .jpg, and delete the original if nothing else uses it.
editor.msg.queue_exists: This skin already has playlist.queue (play queue list).
editor.msg.queue_need_list: playlist.list must exist first: the queue pane is created by splitting it in two.
editor.msg.queue_too_narrow: playlist.list is too narrow; splitting it would leave panes under 40px. Widen it first.
editor.msg.inserted_queue: Inserted playlist.queue: right pane shows the current play queue (no footer), left pane keeps browse tracks, with a splitter between them (remember to save)
editor.comp.label: Label
editor.tip.use_own_opacity: When on, Present overrides the window SourceConstantAlpha for this role’s rect with the role’s own alpha (bg/text color A, or draw opacity). Saves as --use-own-opacity: 1.
